sources.entry: Doughnut - Podcast player and library for mac

summary.one_liner: Doughnut is a native macOS podcast client written in Swift, with a three-column layout inspired by the discontinued Instacast for Mac.
summary.what_it_does: Doughnut is a podcast app for Mac, written in Swift as a 100% native macOS application. Its design follows a three-column layout modeled on Instacast for Mac. The README says it supports an iTunes-style library that can be hosted on an internal or network shared drive. Users can favourite episodes. Users can also create podcasts without a feed, for miscellaneous releases of discontinued shows. The author notes the app was previously built on Electron and used 200+ MB of memory, which motivated the rewrite.
use_cases: listen to podcasts on a Mac
manage a shared podcast library on a network drive
favourite and keep track of podcast episodes
add episodes from discontinued podcasts without a feed
replace a heavy Electron podcast app with a lightweight native one
notable: Three-column layout inspired by Instacast for Mac
iTunes-style library that can live on a network or shared drive
Podcasts can be created without an RSS feed
Rewritten as a native macOS app to replace an earlier Electron version
